_comment: Chemistry review batch 1: the first 60-question chemistry review pack.
The supplied export carried NO bank ids; its Q1-Q60 are display numbers only.
Each item was mapped by matching its ORIGINAL full stem and all four ORIGINAL
option texts against the chemistry bank, then cross-checked three further ways:
(a) the stored answer letter must equal the letter the review asserts,
(b) the whole 60-letter key block must reproduce BDCCBDCCCB CCBBCCABBB
BBBBBBCBBB CBBBCCBBBB BCCBCDCBCC BBBBBCBCCA,
(c) the resulting tally must be A=2, B=33, C=22, D=3, as the review states.
All four agree.
The ids are NOT contiguous. The export skipped two bank records inside the
chem-1..chem-62 span, so the map runs chem-1..chem-18, then chem-20..chem-60
(one step out of phase), then chem-62 for Q60:
chem-19  optical isomerism / enantiomers      - not in the export
chem-61  ideal gas, 300 K -> 600 K at fixed V - not in the export
Both remain unreviewed and are listed under coverage.still_unreviewed_low_ids.
Q21 needed care: chem-22 and chem-257 are near-duplicates, both keyed B and
both asking why phenol is more acidic than ethanol. The review's Q21 names the
old option D as a bond-strength claim, which is chem-22's 'Ethanol has stronger
O-H bonds than phenol'; chem-257's option D is an inductive-effect claim.
chem-22 is the pack item; chem-257 is untouched and still unreviewed.
Q36 and Q60 are kept byte-identical per the review. Q60's explanation keeps its
existing 'Correct Answer: A. 0.95 atm' letter-prefixed heading, which the review
explicitly preserves; every other item in the pack uses an unprefixed heading.
_stem_changes_comment: 19 items, exactly as the review's inventory lists them. Q7 and Q38 are additions
of a stated condition (25 C, constant temperature); the other 17 are full
replacement stems supplied by the review.
_option_changes_comment: Four option texts in four items, exactly as the review's inventory lists them.
Each one's feedback or correct-answer heading is synchronized in the same edit.
_heading_resyncs_comment: Correct-answer headings that were abbreviated relative to their option text.
Q51's resync follows from its new option B; Q50, Q53 and Q54 were already
abbreviated in the bank and the review asks for them to be brought into
agreement. Q60 keeps its existing letter-prefixed heading untouched.
_point_comment: 53 three-point replacements + 7 five-point blocks = 60. Verified against the
bank before editing: the seven items carrying five points are exactly Q13, Q26,
Q33, Q36, Q37, Q56 and Q60, and the other 53 all carry exactly three.
Q36, Q37 and Q60 keep their five points untouched.
_no_table_comment: Verified in the bank before editing. No table is added to any of these, and
every other item keeps exactly one table.

deviations.what: Two em dashes in the retained option C and option D feedback were replaced with ordinary punctuation.
deviations.why: The review did not ask for this. The bank's own convention is no em dashes: only 6 occur across all 485 chemistry records and none as an entity, so these two were inconsistent with surrounding text. Changed because Q40 was already being edited for its option A feedback and point block.

coverage._note: This pack is awaiting final scientific content approval; implementation success is separate from scientific approval.
